items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Fu Klo' and expresses confusion about the name. The interviewer clarifies that 'Robert Lewis' is the name for 'Fu Klo' who plays bass drum. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship, only that the interviewer mentioned him.

ctx.x: Yeah, you mentioned him. Yeah, you mentioned him. I had him mixed up with what I'm telling you, but we usually call him Fu Klo.

Fu Klo? Yeah, Sun. There's Fu Klo that's still playing. Robert Lewis, is that his name, plays bass drum. Sun Fu Klo. Yeah, he's still playing. There's another one they call Sun on the drums. So Fu Klo was kind of tall.
Kind of tall, yeah. He is playing drums. Yeah, he's playing in the Eureka band.
